entry.summary: Today is the final day to vote in Oregon’s May 19 Primary Election. Douglas County voters must return ballots by 8 p.m. tonight. As of the latest unofficial report, about 28% of eligible Douglas County ballots had been received.

entry.title: Oregon Employment Department Releases 2026 Careers Magazine
entry.summary: Oregon’s 2026 Careers magazine is now available for free in English and Spanish, offering students, job seekers and career changers guidance on training, interviews, job searches and in-demand occupations across the state.
